source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative file LF, sorted over five files_sha256; report/log excluded

protocol_map.verification: Full local source SHA256, byte length and Git blob checked against acquisition receipt. Used as data only; original code rewritten without copying implementation/comments/tables.
facts: Ring-info prefix gives descriptor memory and H2D write/read-index addresses
16-byte descriptor, depth at+4/u16, item length+6/u16, 64-bit buffer address+8
TCM indices are16-bit at4-byte strides when DMA-index mode disabled
Publish producer index before BCM ring bell: BAR0+0x2000+0x140 or DAR+0xa20, value1
protocol_map.not_used: No GPL file or pcie-apple.c copy source. No T8103 MSI register layout invented; BCM endpoint doorbell is not host-controller MSI setup.

fake_model.parent: Unchanged bct_session in BCT_SHARED, with stable window/shared metadata and the checked fake BCM accessor.
fake_model.ring_scope: One H2D ring0, depth2..16/item4..64bytes, exactly depth*item<=1024bytes in preallocated ordinary caller RAM. No allocator, firmware-image bytes, DART mapping or DMA.
fake_model.descriptor: Require all4 initial descriptor words zero and low16 producer/consumer indices0. Preserve descriptor word0; write symbolic label low/high, then merged depth/item word, verify readback.
fake_model.address_label: Supplied nonzero aligned64-bit fake label only; never converted to a pointer or claimed physical DMA address. Fixture0x100000004 checks both halves.
fake_model.metadata_policy: All ranges inside explicit fake BCM RAM; reject overlap between descriptor/index spans and protected metadata, and between protected spans themselves. Shared header guard120bytes covers fields through+116. Ring-info guard64bytes is conservative validation policy, not an inferred exact C ABI size.
fake_model.index_contract: TCM low16 with high16 sentinel preserved. Existing word-only fake accessor uses serialized32-bit RMW solely as simulation; no real-device access-width/coherency contract admitted.
fake_model.queue_policy: One slot empty, reject FULL without overwriting unread data. Fresh producer must equal cached owner index; consumer within depth; wrap modulo depth.
submission_order: Copy one opaque synthetic item to preallocated host slot
Publish low16 producer preserving adjacent halfword
Write1 to BCM endpoint BAR0 normal0x2140 or DAR0x2a20
fake_model.partial_failure: Dirty/inflight retained, fault latched after I/O/verify or any partial mutation. Failed write may already have applied. No hidden retry, index rollback, descriptor clearing or free. Readback-confirmed publication and attempted notification are distinct from actual backend-write evidence.
fake_model.logical_close: Requires observed consumer==published/cached producer. Retires model only, retains descriptor/buffer and does not claim physical DMA/IRQ drain.
fake_model.caller_lifetime: Stable disjoint caller storage and serialized parent/ring/fake device, no metadata/window mutation during ownership. Fake consumer updates are direct test stimuli, not actual firmware execution.

gates.readiness: PHY0 reset clear/REQ+ACK ready; RUN/LINK UP, no BUSY/L2; PCI14e4:4425; final PHY recheck. Guard before each API/read/write and before buffer commit.
gates.reset_or_down: Every entry refuses before source, descriptor/index/BAR or host-buffer changes. Late guard loss stops subsequent writes, retaining partial fault evidence if earlier healthy steps already mutated.
gates.default_kernel: All4 APIs return BCR_GATED with zero I/O/buffer changes. KERNEL+fake or shared PHY/PMGR fake-write escape compile-refused. No GPIO152 or SMC command path.
gates.hardware_absent: No device open, physical mapping, hardware register writes, IRQ registration, DMA allocation, firmware image or start, kernel collection or packet integration.

validation.mutation_rule: Unmodified baseline must compile/run first; every counted mutant compiles then fails an assertion. Compile errors do not count.

initial_run.cause: Functional cases passed; one mutant failed compilation due unused parameter, and late-reset mutant survived an early redundant-guard stimulus. Both preserved, not counted as detections.

validation.final_corrections: Mutant explicitly void-casts unused parameter so it compiles. Added reset stimulus at final pre-copy guard, catching forbidden host-buffer mutation. Tightened120/64-byte metadata guard bands and mutual overlap tests before freeze.
validation.fixture_measurement_scope: Unchanged predecessor bct_init/identify/select_window/discover_shared runs with healthy fake PHY/link before ring measurements. Its one fake selector write is not hidden as a whole-boot zero-write claim; new-operation delta and byte snapshots are checked.
validation.repository_wide_checks: Not rerun for this bounded host-only slice. No hardware survey or previous receipt is regenerated.

remaining_real_driver_gaps: Genuine chip/firmware identity and owned coherent ring backing
True16-bit TCM access and device/CPU publication barriers
DART/DMA admission, peer lifecycle and descriptor/firmware contract
Actual msgbuf item formats/sizing, completion/rx/flowrings and interrupt service
Safe physical teardown, transaction/IRQ drain and retained backing on failure
stop_boundary: One source/host receipt only. No boot packet, actual ring allocation/DMA or hardware admission.
